what: Longest long step, in seconds per kilometre of grid spacing, that held a bell ridge across the grid in a uniform cross-ridge wind for the stated seconds through the production step(): generated 49-level ladder, etac from the vertical survey, epssm 0.5, smdiv 0.1, emdiv 0.01, w_damping 1, sixth-order filter 0.12 slope-tapered, Rayleigh lid from 5 km below the 20 km top.  Held means the run finished and the peak vertical velocity stayed under 4 x wind x slope + 20 m/s.  Each wind was tried from the step the weaker wind held, down the ladder (to 0.5 s/km in the first stage, to 1.25 s/km after); null means no ladder step held.  The probe domain is periodic and 96 to 256 columns wide; from 50 m/s up, where the flow crosses such a domain inside the stated seconds, every held step was run again on a domain of (wind x seconds + 10 ridge half-widths) / spacing columns, which the flow cannot wrap, and walked down the ladder where it stopped there.  Every pick the rule makes at 1 and 3 km from the generated step under 40 to 80 m/s was then run three hours on a ridge whose flow cannot wrap the domain in that time; where one stopped, the row's entry is the longest step that held three hours there, or null.  At 3 km, the rows of crests 1.5 to 4.5 km and ridge slopes 0.1 to 0.4 were then tried at longer steps, from 40 s down to 20 s (13.33 to 6.67 s/km) at 20 to 90 m/s on four and six substeps, on a domain the flow cannot wrap: each wind from the step the weaker wind held, where the row held the ladder top at that wind and every weaker one.  Every step held that way was run three hours and walked down the same steps where it stopped, back to the row's own entry where none held.  top_s_per_km is the longest step tried at each wind; an entry equal to it held every step tried there.

adaptive.what: The same ridges on the production adaptive clock: gpuwm.core.adaptive_timestep.AdaptiveTimestepController fed the dycore's own WRF CFL after every step, WRF's substep count from the live step (map factor 1), min_time_step 3 x dx, landing on every hour, from a first step of the ladder's top (5 s/km), for the stated seconds under the same held criterion.  adaptive_s_per_km is, per wind, the longest max_time_step from ladder_s_per_km (longest first) that held at every CFL target pair in targets, with growth bounded at max_step_increase_pct; each wind was tried from the step the weaker wind held, and past a wind that held none the stronger winds were not run.  adaptive_top_s_per_km is the longest max_time_step tried at each wind (null where the wind was not run); an entry below it saw a longer one stop, and a null entry under a tried range means none tried held.  Four-substep rows only: the adaptive clock reads the map at the count it takes at its shortest steps.
